mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, merchant_name, merchant_number, status, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM merchant_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_application (application_id, merchant_name, merchant_number, status, failure_reason) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantNumber}, #{status}, #{failureReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_application SET merchant_number = #{merchantNumber}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND merchant_number IS NULL
